statement: A one-page website for Brew Lab where visitors find what they need and come in
standards: Fast first screen on a phone
done_when: The menu with prices is shown
The address and a map link are shown
Visitors can pre-order a coffee for pickup with a form
A section about the beans and the farms they come from
A loyalty-card explainer (buy 9, get the 10th free)
open_inputs: Real prices, hours, address and photos
